searchText: meh, not convinced re https://github.com/ethereum/beacon-APIs/issues/349 to begin with researchers need to have more solid basis for comparison anyway than relying on the spec, need to understand/maybe instrument each client regardless also, it's sampling anyway, if one truly wants to measure gossip propagation per se, it doesn't require multiple client software even Some p2p snooper would void the need for "Add block_gossip SSE event #405", but I would like to properly spec the existing `block` event. Anyone against "Specify 'valid' condition for block SSE event #404" stating that the event should be emitted only after: - valid state transition (super-set of gossip rules) + valid/syncing execution + DA checks oh, no objections to specifying the existing `block` event more precisely `execution_payload_value` returned from `produceBlockV3` should be expressed in Wei, right? Looks like only the headers have the description but both `execution_payload_value` and `consensus_block_value` should be in Wei. The PR https://github.com/ethereum/beacon-APIs/pull/400 to clarify this was just merged.

- valid state transition (super-set of gossip rules) + valid/syncing execution + DA checks
